<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const setupRevealKeyboardSupport = () => {
    const viewport = document.querySelector(".reveal-viewport") || document.body;
    const focusDeck = () => {
      try {
        viewport.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
        viewport.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } catch (_) {}
      try {
        document.body.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } catch (_) {}
    };

    focusDeck();
    ["pointerdown", "mousedown", "touchstart", "click"].forEach((eventName) => {
      window.addEventListener(eventName, focusDeck, true);
    });

    window.addEventListener(
      "keydown",
      (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        const tagName = target?.tagName?.toUpperCase?.() || "";
        const isEditable =
          target?.isContentEditable ||
          ["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT", "BUTTON"].includes(tagName);

        if (isEditable || !window.Reveal) {
          return;
        }

        switch (event.key) {
          case "ArrowRight":
          case "PageDown":
          case " ":
            event.preventDefault();
            window.Reveal.next();
            break;
          case "ArrowLeft":
          case "PageUp":
            event.preventDefault();
            window.Reveal.prev();
            break;
          case "ArrowDown":
            event.preventDefault();
            window.Reveal.down ? window.Reveal.down() : window.Reveal.next();
            break;
          case "ArrowUp":
            event.preventDefault();
            window.Reveal.up ? window.Reveal.up() : window.Reveal.prev();
            break;
          case "Home":
            event.preventDefault();
            window.Reveal.slide(0);
            break;
          default:
            break;
        }
      },
      true
    );
  };

  if (window.Reveal?.isReady?.()) {
    setupRevealKeyboardSupport();
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("load", setupRevealKeyboardSupport, { once: true });
  }
});
</script>
